title.zh: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
title.en: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities

current_state.zh: A new arXiv paper shows that arbitrary capabilities can be provably hidden inside AI model weights in a way that survives inspection, prompting discussion of open-weights supply-chain risk and sleeper-agent concerns.
